Admin operations MCP server for Chartiko
user_visible_behavior: An Admin (or an AI assistant acting for an Admin) can connect an MCP client such as Claude Code to Chartiko and operate the backend through authorized tools instead of root SSH: read ingestion status, run logs, users/sessions summaries and a health report, and, as explicitly confirmed actions, trigger or retry an ingestion run and end a user's sessions. Registered Users and Visitors get no access.
verification: MCP server is served by Laravel over HTTPS (Streamable HTTP) under the existing domain, implemented with the official laravel/mcp package or an equivalent maintained library; it reuses the existing Admin services/controllers instead of duplicating business logic

Authentication uses a dedicated, revocable, expiring Admin-only credential (Sanctum token with explicit abilities or OAuth); requests without a token get 401, non-admin tokens 403; tokens are never logged, are listed/revocable from the Admin area and every MCP call is audited (tool, actor, outcome) with the same 90-day retention rules

Read-only tools: ingestion_status, list_runs, run_log, users_summary, active_sessions, activity_log and health (queue backlog/failures, last ingestion pipeline, PgBouncer/DB reachability, last backup age); outputs are bounded, paginated and never expose passwords, session ids/payloads, tokens or .env secrets

Write tools (trigger_run, retry_run, end_user_sessions) require a separate token ability, reuse the same validation as the REST API (422/404 semantics), protect the caller's current session, and are clearly marked as destructive/side-effecting in their MCP annotations
No shell, SQL, file-system or arbitrary artisan execution is exposed; the server cannot read secrets or change configuration, deployment, roles or users

Rate limited per token; tool schemas documented; a feature test suite covers 401/403, abilities, every tool's happy path and validation errors, audit rows and absence of secrets; an MCP client smoke test (e.g. MCP Inspector or Claude Code) is recorded

Docs explain how to issue/revoke a token and connect Claude Code (claude mcp add --transport http ...), and record that the temporary root SSH key can be retired once operations move to this server; .\init.ps1 and CI (SQLite + PostgreSQL) pass
notes: Added to the backlog on 2026-10-08 at user request, to be done later. Motivation: day-to-day production operation currently relies on a temporary root SSH key; an authorized, audited MCP over the Admin API removes that need. Out of scope: product-facing/Copilot MCP (screener/instrument tools for end users, AI Copilot is outside the MVP), database or shell access, role management. Related open risk: retire the temporary root key and disable sshd PasswordAuthentication once this exists. Spec: docs/specs/admin-ops-mcp.md (2026-10-16): laravel/mcp ^1.0 at /api/mcp/admin (bearer-only, no Nginx change), Sanctum tokens with mcp:read/mcp:write and mandatory expiry <= 90 days, 9 read + 3 write tools sharing extracted Admin services with REST, mcp_audit_events with 90-day pruning, health tool fed by a backup status file. No product code added yet.
